event.title: The Taper Tantrum
event.summary: Fed chair Bernanke signalled the central bank would start reducing (tapering) bond purchases, sending bond yields sharply higher.

reason: Today's headlines resemble the Taper Tantrum as they discuss the Federal Reserve's potential rate hikes and their impact on the stock market and gold prices, similar to the market's reaction to Bernanke's tapering announcement in 2013.
